title: Evaluation of the Acceptance Formula
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s,C\in\mathbb N$ with $C\ge |Q|+6k+5$, where $Q$ is its state set. For any Boolean input $x$ of length $n$ and any configuration $c$ on that input, the acceptance formula evaluated on the configuration's encoded bit string is true exactly when $c$ is halted and its output is exactly the one-symbol string $[\mathrm{true}]$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
n, s, and C are natural numbers
C is at least the number of states of M plus 6k+5
x is a Boolean input of length n
c is a configuration of M on input x
